5332.title: Pi command-shim launch mismatch
5332.rootCauseOneLine: The Pi version probe invokes the bare command through execFile rather than its portable RPC launch path; Windows extra-pipe inheritance remains unverified.
5332.proposedFix: First verify native Windows command resolution and extra-pipe exchange, then consider shared direct-runtime launch resolution for the existing Pi paths.
5332.caveats: Two clean Linux runs confirm only the synthetic shim-only probe failure and explicit-Node control, not the complete Windows/npm installation or descriptor failure. The test is embedded in the report. No production fix was submitted.
